risposte.testo:
Done: the kickoff note for the Harbor pilot.

The Harbor pilot starts with the finance team and two engineers, working on supplier invoices first: the flow with the most volume and the clearest rules. In the first week we connect the shared folder and the invoice inbox, and we agree with Nora on the three checks that matter most to the team.

In the second week the engineers run the daily brief for the team lead, and every invoice that needs a human decision is flagged with the reason in one line. Nothing is sent or paid without a person pressing the button, and the team keeps its current tools.

At the end of the two weeks we review the numbers with the CFO: invoices handled, time saved per invoice, and the cases the pilot got wrong. That review decides whether the pilot extends to the other two sites in December.

From Nora's mail [1].
I assumed Tuesday, October 6 as the kickoff.
